thread:
Devin: Noting a weird P99 wobble on /v1/chat that coincided with yesterday's quota fallback tweak. p50/p95 flat, p99 +180ms.
Tess: Classic symptom: sample count changed? When we route to fallback we apply 1/10 sampling at ingress for telemetry.
Devin: Yep 40k -> 7.2k for that cohort in the 5m window.
Aj: When tdigest merges have very different n the tail can jump. We don't currently keep raw sample counts in the rollup payload so UI can't tell.
Priya: From the ops side, folks will escalate if they see p99 moving without context. We should make low-confidence obvious.
Tess: Proposal: show a small sample_count badge next to each percentile and a chevron tooltip with sample_origin (ingress-sampled / aggregator-merged / raw).
Aj: Backend change: extend rollup proto with `merged_count` and optional `raw_count`. Aggregator preserves both during downsampling. UI shows raw_count when present and falls back to merged_count.
Samir: Also capture routing-policy snapshot id in the rollup metadata so we can correlate routing_weight changes to metric flips later.
Devin: UX: if p99 delta > 40ms and sample_count decreased > 70% annotate the graph with "likely telemetry sampling / routing artifact" and link to the rollup snapshot.
Priya: Can we add a low-confidence icon (tiny triangle) when n < 1000 and an explanation: "low sample confidence  percentile unstable due to aggressive downsampling or routing fallback"
Tess: Agree. And add an expandable line in the tooltip: "counts: raw=7120 merged=1800; origin=ingress-sampled; routing-snapshot=policy-2026-03-22-19:01"
Aj: Implementation notes: tests need to assert tdigest merge preserves counts and that merged_count is the weight sum used. We'll add a migration path for historical rollups: new field default null.
Samir: I'll run a quick query across endpoints to find other spikes correlated with sample_count drops and paste top 10 in the RFC.
console-bot: infra-bot: RFC created: "expose-sample-count-and-origin-badges" -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls/4242 by Tess.
Devin: Great. Let's make the UI change behind a flag first and roll to internal users. That avoids waking up customers if it introduces a bug.
Priya: Also recommend we surface this in the oncall playbook: how to interpret low-sample pctl warnings during rollouts.
Tess: I'll mock the badge + tooltip and include the routing-snapshot field in the proto spec. Assign Aj for aggregator, Samir for telemetry audit, Priya for ops playbook.
Aj: ETA for proto + tests: 3d. UI mock + flag: 5d.
Devin: Thanks all. This should cut down false-positive p99 alerts during routing/quotas rollouts. 
Tess: Adding follow-ups in the PR: migration notes, dashboard annotation rule, and sample-origin legends.
Devin: Ping me on the PR for acceptance criteria.
